bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
stage="$repo/.worktrees/menu-hotfix-runtime-dual-20261115"
candidate=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-hotfix-0bbf7c6
compose="$repo/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)" = 57955cd68bb39626ebbca38d44b7bb034da6dc05 || exit 74
test "$(sha256sum "$stage/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 76ccecd409e9c6ec0515a3f6d8f72063b26ffedaa32c1e47cd8e7b7054109d62 || exit 74
test "$(sha256sum "$stage/publishMenuPanels.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 46f007a7a15fefd918d2bd443e492cac2e7542c19b7bd2aac5382b1101f7f036 || exit 74
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$candidate")" || exit 74
test -f "$compose" || exit 67
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" config --quiet || exit 68
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -aq --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || exit 64
cid="${ids[0]}"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Name}}' "$cid")" = /deploy-gaybbs-1 || exit 64
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$cid")" = true || exit 63
oldid="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$cid")"
if test "$oldid" = "$newid"; then
 echo GAYBBS_CANDIDATE_ALREADY_ACTIVE=PASS
 exit 0
fi
docker image tag "$oldid" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-creator-20261115
cat > "$stage/gaybbs-c094-live.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  gaybbs:
    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-hotfix-0bbf7c6
    pull_policy: never
YAML
cat > "$stage/gaybbs-c094-rollback.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  gaybbs:
    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-creator-20261115
    pull_policy: never
YAML
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$stage/gaybbs-c094-live.yaml" config --quiet || exit 69
changed=0
rollback(){ rc=$?; trap - ERR; set +e; if test "$changed" = 1; then docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$stage/gaybbs-c094-rollback.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED=PASS || echo ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED=FAIL;fi;exit "$rc"; }
trap rollback ERR
changed=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$stage/gaybbs-c094-live.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps gaybbs >/dev/null
sleep 9
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$newid" || false
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || false
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -c 'test -s /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "クリエーター投稿" /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "dm:talk" /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "dm:invite" /app/gaybbs.mjs && grep -q "dm:link" /app/gaybbs.mjs' || false
trap - ERR
echo GAYBBS_MENU_DEPLOY=PASS
echo SOURCE_BUNDLE_SHA=0bbf7c677a22dd63eeadb153404a1c0fdffa2ccb
echo CONTAINER_RUNNING=YES
